recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, high-contrast J-card layout featuring a blue-tinted, textured background with a vertical spine, a central portrait, and bold, overlapping sans-serif typography that mimics the DIY aesthetic of 1990s underground music culture.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical spine contrasting with a horizontal main panel
High-contrast portrait integrated into a textured, monochromatic blue field
Aggressive typographic hierarchy with tight letter-spacing
Graphic line work (heartbeat/pulse motif) grounding the bottom composition
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and photocopy noise

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-close portrait of a male figure positioned in the upper right quadrant, partially obscured by text and background textures.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold vertical text on the left spine acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the vertical spine, across the large display title at the top, down to the portrait, and finally to the tracklist details in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with texture, circular ripple patterns, and layered text blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cobalt and navy blue providing a moody, monochromatic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for primary display typography to ensure legibility against dark backgrounds.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale cream or off-white for secondary text to create a subtle hierarchy.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between dark background and bright text; low saturation except for the blue channel.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to blue, black, and white/cream

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and scales of the same sans-serif family to maintain a cohesive, industrial look.
graphicDevices: Vertical divider line for the spine

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tight, bold, industrial feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the spine text.
Offers a similar grotesque skeleton with high impact.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark, textured background using deep blue and black. Incorporate heavy film grain, photocopy artifacts, and a subtle circular ripple pattern. Place a high-contrast, desaturated portrait in the upper right, blended into the blue tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white, condensed sans-serif text. Place a large vertical title on the left spine. Add a large horizontal title at the top, slightly overlapping the portrait. Use smaller, off-white text for secondary details in the lower right. Include a sharp white pulse line at the bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Is the blue wash consistent across the image?
Is the tracking on the display text tight enough to feel aggressive?
Does the spine text run vertically from bottom to top?
Is there visible texture/noise across the entire composition?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not have drop shadows
Verify the vertical spine is clearly demarcated
Confirm the blue is a deep cobalt rather than a bright cyan
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Blue + High-Contrast Portrait + Condensed Bold Sans-Serif + Photocopy Texture = 90s Underground Mixtape Aesthetic
